name: Amanda Hart
life: “I still remember leaning over a stair rail to hear a concert.” Wednesday often includes a stop at the public road outside the Port of Asphalt, where Amanda can recognize shift change by the lull between two groups of walkers.
voice: I live above the landing. I offered my breakfast hour for a concert while we figure it out.
appearance: Amanda is easy to recognize by a loose dark braid and a heart-shaped face and prominent ears. Usually dressed in an olive canvas jacket with a tiny red thread tied through the lowest buttonhole, Amanda rubs a thumb along the edge of the nearest pocket when listening.
personality: Amanda has an appetite for a good argument about little things and works hard to keep a serious disagreement from being turned into entertainment.
agenda: To give the stranded piano a breakfast audience.
family: Rafe Costa is Amanda’s half-sibling. Amanda asks the question the rest of the family avoided. Rafe chooses an ordinary story to tell. They tend to get further with an important subject when it arrives in the middle of talk about dinner or work. Asked about *The empty berth*, Rafe says, “My father tied up here before there was a gate.”
connections: Kit Porter. A breakfast listener gives the child an unhurried first audience.

reactions.situation: A neighbor demands that the piano be taken off the landing
reactions.response: Amanda asks how much clear passage is needed today before arranging another move.

reactions.situation: The last bus leaves while an elderly stranger is still crossing toward it
reactions.response: Amanda offers to walk to the next staffed place together, at the stranger's pace, to ask about another ride.

reactions.situation: When a private quarrel becomes a public joke
reactions.response: Amanda says the plainest truthful thing possible and changes the subject.
